scientific_integrity: Proof by exact flow reduction, fractional composition, geometric-series asymptotics, and Jacobian decomposition; rational checker executed successfully. No independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic n-species systems with shared per-capita rank-one crowding, bounded periodic coefficients, a positive seasonal crowding integral for every species, and a fixed finite schedule of positive multiplicative pulses only. No general competition matrices, state-dependent pulses, noise, or nonlinear pulse effects. The motivating full preprint was not inspected. The underlying one-period Leslie–Gower map class is established literature; the proposed contribution is exact asynchronous-pulse realization and global timing-insensitive selection including all critical and neutral cases.
title: Pulse-time invariance and complete global selection in shared-crowding competition
